title: Monthly Roadmap Synthesis & Tactical Decision Ledger for Runtime Investments
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Purpose: Produce a concise monthly synthesis and a 'decision ledger' capturing durable asks, tactical gating criteria, and committed next-actions for runtime/performance investments. This artifact will be used for the upcoming leadership readout and to drive follow-through across Eng, Research, and Finance. Scope: runtime investments (batching, KV caching, kernel selection, Dedicated autoscaling policy), not long-term model R&D. Outcome: a single-page synthesis + appendix with data-backed trade-offs and an actionable ledger of owners, due dates, and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: One-page synthesis slide summarizing current runway, three prioritized asks, and expected impact (latency %, unit-cost %),
Decision ledger table (owner, decision, gating criteria, due date, fallback),
Supporting appendix with perf delta curves and cost model links,
Stakeholder sign-off from Eng, Research, Finance, and Product by 2026-03-20
agenda: Synthesis: Where we are vs commit (6m)
deliverables: action-items JIRA/Linear tickets created and linked
decisions: Prefer rollout via canary+observability gates rather than large batch holiday deploys to limit blast radius; agreed by Eng and Research
Prioritize KV-cache improvement (medium effort) as #1 ask because it shows best latency/unit-cost ratio for typical workloads
Defer kernel-level micro-optimizations for Q3 unless a high-frequency customer pattern emerges
tradeoffs: KV-cache improvement increases memory footprint and marginal cost on Dedicated but reduces per-token latency across bursty workloads; Finance requested projection to 12 months of TPU/GPU spend,
Aggressive batching reduces cost but increases P95 latency; accepted for background embedding jobs but not for interactive chat routes
Quantization recommendations reduce unit-cost but require extra QA for fidelity-sensitive customers; plan conservative rollout with evaluation harness
notes: This ticket synthesizes information from two running experiments (batching policy A/B and KV-cache LRU tweak). Use appendix to show sensitivity analysis for the top three customers. Ensure Finance model reflects both Hosted and Dedicated margin impacts.
